title: Buildings That Show Their Work
interpretation: The board, portable plan objects and easel are original gameplay devices. They do not claim a documented planning institution or blueprint practice at Yenikapı.

field_extension.benefit: More food per food worker; needs a staffed harvest.

shared_store.benefit: 120 more storage places; tending and supplies still needed.

watch_shelter.benefit: A small watch shelter and improved protection with watch workers.

care_shelter.benefit: A shared care room; care and cooperation still need workers.

north_lane.benefit: Access to the earlier northern and eastern household sites.

north_home.benefit: Six housing places; arrivals still need food and wellbeing.

east_home.benefit: Six housing places; arrivals still need food and wellbeing.

refuge_screen.benefit: A low refuge screen and a gathering point improve protection.

council_ground.benefit: A shared place for cooperation; no new office or resources.

exchange_place.benefit: A meeting room; optional contacts become available at town readiness.

land_court_home.benefit: Six housing places; closes three shared construction places.

land_hearth_home.benefit: Six housing places; closes three work places and costs four cooperation.

land_outer_west.benefit: Six housing places; retains central work ground. Access needs upkeep.

land_outer_east.benefit: Six housing places; retains central work ground. Access needs upkeep.

land_outer_access.benefit: Enables outer homes; needs one adult and one opening timber each season.

land_cultivate.benefit: Eight more provisions per staffed harvest. Commits this field.

land_provisioning.benefit: Four work places and 60 storage; loses eight provisions per staffed harvest.

land_adapt_workroom.benefit: Four additional construction places; keeps the room and its doorway.

living_shared_room.benefit: Enables two-adult shared preparation. Cooperation needs practice and support.

living_watch_kits.benefit: Four serviceable wooden kits; watch staff, practice and upkeep still matter.

living_north_post.benefit: A northern post; two watch adults and maintained facilities support upper timber.

incident_approach_prepare.benefit: Reduces approach severity by two if finished before resolution.

incident_approach_repair.benefit: Restores loaded northern access and removes its timber penalty.

incident_stores_prepare.benefit: Reduces waterside severity by two and protects up to 12 provisions.

incident_stores_repair.benefit: Restores productive waterside handling; earlier losses remain recorded.

ui.room_note: Interpretive gameplay plans in the existing working room. Select a plan on the board, then click the easel to manage it.
ui.investment: Paid materials stay committed. Piles illustrate that payment; they are not extra supplies.
ui.refund: Cancel returns {wood} timber + {blanks} prepared; completed work is not refunded.
ui.cause_paused: Paused by your order; structure and paid materials remain.
ui.cause_crew: Crew limit is zero. Allocate a crew to request seasonal work.
ui.cause_labor: Adults are allocated to earlier duties. Raise priority, reduce competing work or wait.
ui.cause_space: Shared construction places are allocated elsewhere. Pause a project or add working space.
ui.cause_access_disabled: Northern access upkeep is switched off. Enable its ordinary upkeep order.
ui.cause_access_incident: Approach damage impairs loaded access. Complete the approach repair; pedestrian paths remain open.
ui.cause_access_materials: Northern access needs opening timber after household fuel and earlier upkeep.
ui.cause_access_labor: Northern access needs its adult upkeep crew before outer work can proceed.
ui.cause_workroom: The working room needs maintenance; reduced construction yield applies.
ui.cause_ready: Assigned adults will perform the forecast work when you resolve the season.
ui.cause_complete: The project is complete. Its normal operating requirements still apply.
ui.cause_unpaid: Review requirements, then commission using village stock.
ui.manual: This older village uses its saved manual workforce. Manage allocation in the detailed ledger.
ui.plan_hint: Select a plan object, then the easel.
ui.stage_hint: Stage reflects saved work, not elapsed time.
ui.legend: Hammer: work · II: paused · person: short crew · !: blocked · tool: repair
ui.overview_note: Compare paid work, finite crews and next-season progress. Select any plan for the shared project controls.
